messages:
emma: Hey team — customer MetroDocs reports their free-trial credits fell from 5000 -> 0 overnight. They say their nightly doc-vec-sync hasn't changed. From our logs I see ~120k embedding calls hitting /v1/embeddings between 00:03 and 00:15 UTC. Request IDs: 01GZ4X..., 01GZ4Y..., 01GZ4Z... Any quick ideas before I reply?

jordan: Do we know which API key/org those calls used? Was a promo code attached?

emma: Org id is org_7metro. They did have a promo header on previous runs: X-Promo: TRIAL-BOOST. Recent runs show the header missing on most requests.

support-bot: Trace summary for thread 2198880001 -> embedded trace: fallback path hit 73 times, retry policy invoked 3x per chunk, individual batch-splits created additional child requests. 504s from embeddings-us-east-1 between 00:02:58 - 00:04:12.

raja: Triage update: looks like the scheduled worker ran into transient 504s from embeddings, triggered our batch-splitter fallback which re-sends chunked requests. There's a bug where we don't propagate request metadata during the split+retry path — specifically X-Promo is dropped. That means the split requests were billed normally (no promo) and also multiple duplicates were sent because idempotency keys are generated per original chunk incorrectly.

raja: Quick repro (in our worker):
```python
# buggy splitter path
for chunk in split(data):
    headers = req.headers.copy()
    headers.pop('X-Promo', None)  # <-- oops, this removes promo for fallback chunks
    post('/v1/embeddings', json=chunk, headers=headers)
```

raja: Consequences: (1) promo not applied to most split requests -> trial credits consumed; (2) idempotency keys not preserved across splitter -> duplicates when retrying.

jordan: Rough numbers? how many duplicate requests / how much credit?

raja: Estimated duplicates ~34k embedding calls (we double-sent many chunks). Token-equivalent ~= 8.9k embedding units charged against their trial. Time window matches their reported drop.

jordan: Ok, we should offer a refund for the consumed trial credits and fix the worker. Can we also dedupe responses so downstream indexes don't duplicate?

raja: Yes — mitigation plan:
- Patch: preserve headers and idempotency key in splitter path (hotfix roll in next 2 hrs).
- Run a dedupe job to remove duplicate vectors (I can run with read-only verification first).
- Billing: issue trial credit refund of ~8.9k embedding units and mark the invoice as adjusted.

billing-team: Acknowledged. Please file a refund ticket with org_id=org_7metro, amount_units=8900, reason="system-splitter duplicate charges; promo header dropped". I'll expedite.

emma: I'll reply to the customer with a short summary and say we're issuing the refund and rolling a hotfix. Draft reply: "We're sorry — a retry/split bug caused duplicate embedding requests which dropped your trial balance. We will refund the consumed trial credits and deploy a fix within a few hours. We'll follow up when complete." OK to send?

jordan: Send it. Add that we will confirm when dedupe and refund are done. :thumbsup:

raja: Rolling hotfix now, posting deploy result in ~10m. :eyes:

emma: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and close after refund confirmed. :refund:
